specs.title: TC-01: login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: 1. Open the login page /#/login
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu: it shows Login and not the email
4. Log in with the email and the correct password
5. Open the account menu: it shows the email and Logout

specs.title: TC-02: add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list: the product, its price and Add to Basket; basket counter 0
2. Click Add to Basket: message and basket counter 1
3. Open the basket: one row with name, quantity 1 and price
4. The basket total is 8.99¤

specs.title: TC-03: change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket: A and B with quantity 1, total 13.98¤, counter 2
2. Click plus on A: A has quantity 2, total 18.97¤, counter 3
3. Click minus on A: A has quantity 1, total 13.98¤, counter 2
4. Click minus on A again: A keeps quantity 1 and stays in the basket, total 13.98¤
5. Click trash on A: no row for A, B stays with quantity 1, total 8.99¤, counter 1

specs.title: TC-04: purchase limit for one product

steps.title: 1. Add the product from the product list: message and counter 1
2. Click plus until the quantity is 5: no error, total 9.95¤
3. Click plus once more: the limit error shows
4. The product keeps quantity 5, total 9.95¤, counter 5
5. Add the product again from the product list: the limit error shows, counter 5

specs.title: TC-05: valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, click Checkout: the saved address is shown
2. Select the saved address, click Continue: the delivery speeds are shown
3. Select One Day Delivery, click Continue: the saved card and the coupon panel are shown
4. Open the coupon panel, redeem the coupon of this month: the discount message shows
5. Select the saved card, click Continue: the order summary shows the 10% promotion

specs.title: TC-06: invalid coupon and expired coupon

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, Checkout, select the address, Continue: the delivery page opens
2. Select One Day Delivery, click Continue: the payment page opens
3. Redeem the invalid code: the error shows, no discount message
4. Redeem the coupon of the previous month: the error shows, no discount message
5. Select the saved card, click Continue: the summary shows no promotion
